WITH feb_sales AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_moy = 2
)
SELECT SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) AS return_amt,
       SUM(s.ss_net_paid) AS net_paid,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_joined,
       COUNT(sr.sr_return_amt) AS n_returns
FROM feb_sales s
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number
 AND sr.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk

WITH feb_sales AS (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2001 AND d.d_moy = 2
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(sr.sr_return_amt) / SUM(s.ss_net_paid) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM feb_sales s
LEFT JOIN store_returns sr
  ON sr.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number
 AND sr.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk
